title: Bench pool gap row BP-bac81f87 names a _gaps.md entry a Narrowed note now closes, and still expects the web route
goal: No stored gap row of kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv names a _gaps.md entry that kbfacts.OPEN_GAP reads as closed: the repro exits 0, and a pool gap row stale this way fails a check at the landing that closes its entry, not at a later review

run: import sys,re,hashlib;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts,bench_pool;T=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read();H={hashlib.sha1(re.sub(r'^(Still open|Narrowed, not closed):\s*','',m.group(1)).strip(' .:*').encode()).hexdigest()[:8]:m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(r'^- \*\*(.+?)\*\*.*(?:\n  .+)*',T,re.M)};bad=[r['id'] for r in bench_pool.load_pool(kinds={'gap'}) if kbfacts.OPEN_GAP.search(H.get(r['source'].split('#')[1],'Resolved'))];print('gap rows whose entry is closed:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
